profiles.name: Core suite
profiles.description: The core AI services for local models and embeddings, external provider connections, chat, and web research.

authentik.summary: Manages user accounts and access to Mu3Lab. Authentik provides a shared sign-in for compatible apps and an additional sign-in gate for selected services.

ingress.summary: Routes requests to Mu3Lab apps over HTTPS. Caddy provides the internal web server and reverse proxy used to publish private app addresses.

vaultwarden.summary: Stores passwords, secure notes, and other vault items on your server. Vaultwarden works with Bitwarden clients to sync your vault and fill saved logins across devices.

firecrawl.summary: Converts web pages into Markdown and structured data for AI tools. Mu3Lab runs the self-hosted scraping and crawling API and connects it to chat for web research.
firecrawl.tagline: Turns web pages into AI-ready text
firecrawl.resource_guidance: Runs Firecrawl workers, Playwright, RabbitMQ, PostgreSQL, and Redis. Browser crawls can use substantial memory; concurrency defaults are intentionally conservative.

freellmapi.summary: Connects multiple AI providers through an OpenAI-compatible API, with model routing and automatic failover. Mu3Lab manages provider keys in AI providers settings; availability depends on each provider’s limits.
freellmapi.tagline: Pools free AI providers with failover
freellmapi.resource_guidance: Optional provider route inside the mandatory core suite.

litellm.summary: Provides a unified API for local and external AI models. Mu3Lab uses LiteLLM to route chat and embedding requests through one gateway for connected apps.
litellm.tagline: One gateway for all AI models
litellm.resource_guidance: Low host overhead; provider and model choice determines usage.

lobehub.summary: An AI chat workspace for conversations, assistants, and connected tools. Mu3Lab connects LobeChat to configured models through LiteLLM and stores conversation history on your server.
lobehub.resource_guidance: Runs LobeChat, PostgreSQL, Redis, and private object storage. Expect moderate memory and disk use.

ollama.summary: Runs AI models and generates text embeddings on your server. Mu3Lab uses Ollama as an internal API for local inference and document search; it has no browser interface.
ollama.tagline: Runs AI models on your server
ollama.resource_guidance: Model downloads determine disk and memory use.

actual-budget.summary: A personal finance app built around envelope budgeting. Track accounts and transactions, plan spending, and review financial reports, with budget data synced through your own server.

adventurelog.summary: A travel journal and trip planner for recording places, activities, and past adventures. Organize destinations into collections, plan upcoming trips, and explore your travels on a map.
adventurelog.resource_guidance: Lightweight service with persistent trip data.

baby-buddy.summary: A shared baby-care tracker for feedings, sleep, diaper changes, pumping, and growth. Caregivers can record daily routines and review trends from a common activity history.
baby-buddy.tagline: Baby feeding, sleep, and diaper tracker
baby-buddy.resource_guidance: Lightweight family tracker with durable local data and uploaded media. Authentik creates the Baby Buddy user automatically on first access.

immich.summary: Manages your photo and video library on your server. Upload media from your phone, organize shared albums, and find images using metadata, facial recognition, and visual search.
immich.resource_guidance: Media storage and machine-learning jobs can be resource intensive.

mealie.summary: Organizes household recipes, meal plans, and shopping lists. Import recipes from websites or add your own, schedule meals, and turn recipe ingredients into shopping lists.
mealie.tagline: Recipes, meal plans, and shopping lists

nextcloud.summary: A self-hosted workspace for files, calendars, and contacts. Sync and share files across devices, manage events, and connect a Nextcloud calendar to Mu3Lab’s calendar and Home agenda.
nextcloud.resource_guidance: Stores files and calendar data locally; storage use grows with uploaded content.

paperless-ngx.summary: Turns scanned paperwork and digital files into a searchable document archive. Extract text with OCR, organize documents by tags and correspondents, and find records without sorting through folders.
paperless-ngx.resource_guidance: Storage and OCR usage grow with your document library.

surfsense.summary: An AI research workspace for searching documents and web sources, organizing knowledge, and asking questions with source citations. Mu3Lab connects this self-hosted web app to its AI gateway and local embedding service.
surfsense.resource_guidance: Runs PostgreSQL, Redis, SearXNG, workers, and zero-cache. The privileged SurfSense sandbox is disabled.
